t: You're on Fitzjohns Avenue, a steep street in Hampstead, in the London Borough of Camden. It runs north from College Crescent and becomes Heath Street at Hampstead Village, so you feel the climb for much of its length. Streets such as Belsize Park, Belsize Lane and Maresfield Gardens join or cross it. The writer and doctor Winifred May de Kok died here. She was born in Bethlehem, in the Orange Free State, in 1893, and went to medical school in England in the 1920s.
